notes.summary: The author asks to express the usual six operations on sheaves, including sheaves on unions of strata, in the proposed dictionary and to verify their known formulas again. He suggests that one should form a category of diagrams of semisimplicial sets and then pass to a homotopy category of fractions. He then begins a claim that an equisingular stratification with nonsingular strata of a compact tame space canonically yields a diagram of spaces; the sentence continues beyond this page.
